short_description: A sheer and hydrating water-based bronzer in a Korean-inspired cushion compact for a buildable, weightless wash of natural, sunkissed color.
long_description: What it is: A sheer and hydrating water-based bronzer in a Korean-inspired cushion compact for a buildable, weightless wash of natural, sunkissed color. short_description: A lightweight, buildable liquid-cream bronzer that blends seamlessly into skin for a subtly defined bronze with a dewy, soft-focus finish.

Its chunky doe-foot is designed for the most fool-proof targeted application for both an all-over bronze or a softly sculpted look. how_to_use: Suggested Usage: -Using the chunky doe-foot, dot or swipe Dew Bronze on areas of the face touched by the sun—top of cheekbones, across forehead, and bridge of nose—for a sunkissed bronze. -Dot or swipe in the natural shadows—under cheekbones and jaw—for a soft sculpt. -Press into skin with Saie’s Base Brush (sold separately) to start distributing the pigment over the areas you seek to bronze. -Then, sweep at the edges to blend out until Dew Bronze fades seamlessly into the skin. Recycling Instructions: -Dew Bronze's vial is made of 40 percent post-consumer recycled plastic. -While Dew Blush's components are made of recyclable materials, individual components under two inches do not typically make it through the curbside recycling stream. -Saie works with Pact Collective to make sure your hard-to-recycle items get recycled.
